promotions.behavior: Persisted NPC AI ticks are admitted monotonically and duplicate or regressive ticks are not re-executed
promotions.runtime_impact: prevents duplicate action scheduling after replay, save restoration, or repeated host tick calls
promotions.world_state_impact: last_ai_tick remains the authoritative per-instance admission watermark

promotions.behavior: Non-actionable NPC instances deterministically clear transient target and interaction state while preserving native-only behavior as blocked
assumptions: dead, despawned, and waiting-to-respawn instances cannot retain actionable target or service requests
promotions.safe_fallback: remove only transient runtime metadata and mark hostility dead; do not infer corpse, loot, or respawn semantics
promotions.runtime_impact: prevents stale combat and service handoffs from surviving death-state transitions
promotions.world_state_impact: current_target_id and interaction_request are removed when death-state cleanup is committed

blocked_native: native threat and target memory duration
